properties.name: Tunnel View
properties.note: First look at the Valley, right after the Wawona Tunnel on Hwy 41. Parking both sides of the road.

properties.name: Curry Village
properties.note: Check-in 4:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM. Park once and do not move the car. Front desk 209-372-8333.

properties.name: Happy Isles Trailhead
properties.note: Shuttle stop #16. Start of the John Muir Trail and Mist Trail to Vernal Fall. Mist Trail section closed Mon-Thu 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM.

properties.name: Top of Vernal Fall
properties.note: Reachable via Mist Trail (2.4 mi RT) or John Muir Trail and Clark Point cutoff (5.4 mi RT). Vault toilets nearby. Do not cross railings.

properties.name: Swinging Bridge Picnic Area
properties.note: Shade, picnic tables, grills, and the easiest Merced River swimming in the Valley. Where you ride out the afternoon heat.

properties.name: Glacier Point
properties.note: 60 mile round trip from Curry Village. Lot fills by mid-morning. NO DRINKING WATER, bring your own. Vault toilets only.

properties.name: Sentinel Dome and Taft Point Trailhead
properties.note: One trailhead, two easy hikes. Sentinel Dome 2.2 mi RT for a 360 summit. Taft Point 2.2 mi RT to unrailed granite fissures.

properties.name: Mirror Lake
properties.note: 2 mi RT paved, mostly shaded along Tenaya Creek. Shallow pools by August. Best straight-up view of Half Dome in the park.

properties.name: Yosemite Valley Welcome Center
properties.note: Open 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Confirm Mist Trail closure status here and pick up the current Yosemite Guide for ranger program times.

properties.name: Bridalveil Fall
properties.note: 0.5 mi RT on a rebuilt paved path. Still flowing in August, unlike Yosemite Falls.

properties.name: Wawona Swinging Bridge
properties.note: Half mile flat walk from the lot to a swimming hole on the South Fork Merced. Bring flip flops. Vault toilet at the parking area.

properties.name: Mariposa Grove Welcome Plaza
properties.note: Park here and ride the free shuttle. Grizzly Giant Loop is 2 mi and 300 ft, shaded. Only giant sequoias on this trip.

properties.name: South Entrance Station
properties.note: $35 per vehicle, valid 7 days. Card only, no cash. Pre-buy on Recreation.gov. Expect 30 to 90 minute waits on summer mornings.

properties.name: Oakhurst, CA
properties.note: LAST AFFORDABLE FUEL before the park. There is no gas station in Yosemite Valley. Fill up here in both directions.

properties.name: Lake Arrowhead, CA
properties.note: About 350 miles each way. Route: CA-18 to I-15 N to US-395 N to CA-58 W to CA-99 N to CA-41 N.
